bash -c 
set -e
go build -o ./bin/orchestrator ./cmd/orchestrator
kill $(lsof -ti :8090) 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 0.5
nohup ./bin/orchestrator web --addr 127.0.0.1:8090 >/tmp/orchestrator_web_8090.log 2>&1 &
for i in {1..20}; do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/tasks/detail?task_key=TASK-2 >/tmp/task2_detail.json 2>/dev/null; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.3
done
python3 - << "PY"
import json, urllib.request, os

with open("/tmp/task2_detail.json") as f:
    detail = json.load(f)

task = detail["task"]
subs = detail.get("sub_tasks", [])
assert task["external_id"] == "TASK-2", f"unexpected task: {task}"
assert len(subs) >= 1, "expected at least 1 subtask on TASK-2"

# 1. Verify /task_edit_modal.js is served with 200 OK
req_js = urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8090/task_edit_modal.js", timeout=5)
js_body = req_js.read().decode("utf-8")
assert req_js.status == 200 and "openEditTaskModal" in js_body and "openEditSubTaskModal" in js_body

# 2. Verify POST /api/tasks/update on live :8090 (replan_s1_s3=False) and check 01_requirements.md on disk
update_payload = {
    "task_key": "TASK-2",
    "title": task["title"],
    "description": task["description"],
    "brd_content": detail.get("brd_content", ""),
    "target_repo": task.get("target_repo", ""),
    "affected_repos": task.get("affected_repos", []),
    "complexity": task.get("complexity", "M"),
    "priority": task.get("priority", 2),
    "actor": task.get("actor", "Human"),
    "assigned_model": task.get("assigned_model", ""),
    "replan_s1_s3": False
}
req_up = urllib.request.Request(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/tasks/update",
    data=json.dumps(update_payload).encode("utf-8"),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_up, timeout=10) as resp:
    up_res = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    assert resp.status == 200 and up_res.get("ok") is True and up_res.get("replan") is False

req_md_path = "/Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/ai-orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/TASK-2/01_requirements.md"
assert os.path.exists(req_md_path), "01_requirements.md missing for TASK-2"
with open(req_md_path) as rf:
    req_md = rf.read()
assert task["title"] in req_md, "01_requirements.md does not contain task title"

# 3. Verify POST /api/tasks/subtasks (action=edit_subtask) on live :8090
st0 = subs[0]
sub_payload = {
    "task_key": "TASK-2",
    "action": "edit_subtask",
    "subtask_id": st0["subtask_id"],
    "title": st0["title"],
    "description": st0["description"],
    "group_title": st0.get("group_title", ""),
    "wave_index": st0.get("wave_index", 0),
    "target_repo": st0.get("target_repo", ""),
    "context_file_line": st0.get("context_file_line", ""),
    "test_dod": st0.get("test_dod", ""),
    "assignee": st0.get("assignee", "Coder"),
    "model": st0.get("model", "")
}
req_sub = urllib.request.Request(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/tasks/subtasks",
    data=json.dumps(sub_payload).encode("utf-8"),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_sub, timeout=10) as resp:
    sub_res = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    assert resp.status == 200 and len(sub_res.get("sub_tasks", [])) >= 1

print("LIVE_RUNTIME_8090_E2E_OK", json.dumps({
    "task_key": task["external_id"],
    "title": task["title"],
    "subtasks_count": len(subs),
    "first_subtask_id": st0["subtask_id"],
    "update_status": 200,
    "edit_subtask_status": 200,
    "req_md_bytes": len(req_md)
}, ensure_ascii=False))
